name: DmaBufferToVram
comment: One-shot VRAM DMA. $1D=VMADDR word, $1F=src, $21=src bank, $22=byte count (callers stage it in $DE).

name: WaitVblank
comment: Menu frame boundary. Polls RDNMI, and `inc $16a3` here is the only per-frame tick menus have - NMI is disabled ($4200=0) while a menu is up, so $0092A5 never runs. Menu loops iterate a variable number of times per frame; count frames off $16A3, not loop calls.

name: UpdateCtrlAfterScroll
comment: Post-scroll input fixup; called by the rolling engine's finish_scroll.

name: ReadCtrlAndDispatch
comment: Joypad read + dispatch. Runs once per frame while input flows but ~20 times inside the frame that ends a scroll animation - not a frame tick.
